title: Recipe
description: One cocktail, in data/recipes/<id>.json. Also the format of a recipe shared from the app.

format.description: Only on a recipe shared from the app; leave it out of files in data/recipes/.

formatVersion.description: Only on a recipe shared from the app.

id.description: Stable id, the same as the file name. Never renamed once published, because people's history refers to it.

name.description: The drink's name as the app shows it.

method.description: How it's mixed. dry-shake means shaken without ice first, for egg white.

ingredients.description: What goes in, in the order you add it.

amount.description: How much, in the unit below. Use ml for liquids (22.5 ml is ¾ oz); the app converts to oz for people who prefer it.

unit.description: ml for measured liquids, dash and drop for bitters, rinse for coating the glass, top for filling up with soda or wine.

optional.description: The drink still works without it. Not needed to count as makeable.

garnish.description: A garnish. Shown, but never counted against the recipe when missing.

note.description: A short note on this line ("freshly squeezed", "or a sugar cube").

steps.description: How to make it, one short sentence or two per step.

tags.description: Style tags people can filter by. A new tag means adding it here too.

origin.description: Where and when it comes from, if known ("Florence, around 1919").

why.description: Optional: what makes the drink work, or a tip that isn't obvious from the steps.

contributor.description: Optional: the GitHub name of whoever added it, to credit them in the app.
